g.text: Kontrol verbosity: distribusi panjang penjelasan visible
CANDIDATE | overall | n tersedia / total per persona; verdict-only = 0 kata; missing/technical/unknown = NA
Kotak = IQR; garis hitam = median; titik = rerata; whisker = persentil 5–95, bukan CI. NA ≠ 0.
